title: 2016 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: The War of \(1812\) started with a declaration of war on Thursday, June \(18,\) \(1812.\) The peace treaty to end the war was signed \(919\) days later, on December \(24,\) \(1814.\) On what day of the week was the treaty signed?

solutions.text:
Because \(919=7\cdot131+2,\) the treaty was signed \(131\) full weeks plus \(2\) days after Thursday. Two days beyond Thursday is Saturday.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Days of the week repeat every \(7\) days, so reduce \(919\) modulo \(7\)
\(919=7\cdot131+2,\) so count \(2\) days forward from Thursday
